title: A passionate gravel race as the test bench: AF01 reviewed

takeaways.text: AF claims 425 mm chainstays and a fork with 55 mm offset that clears 700×54 mm tires, a larger front figure than the 50 mm frame clearance usually quoted.
AF claims a one-piece moulded frame of T1000 and M65 fibre with a size M a little over 800 g, a curved seat tube for comfort, and fork mounts moulded in.
The down-tube storage box is said to stay rattle-free and dry inside after a day on rough, muddy gravel.

disclosure: Published by AF Bicycles about its own frame; treat performance statements as manufacturer claims.
summary: Short brand-made race video of the AF01 on a rough gravel circuit, restating geometry, weight and construction claims.
